summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by TRX Gold Corp, a Canadian foreign private issuer, providing unaudited financial statements and management discussion for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026. The filing incorporates these exhibits into existing registration statements and is a routine periodic report. There are no special-situation corporate events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructurings, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or abrupt management changes. No deal terms are present.
